description: Defines structures, enums, and functions for handling WebSocket frames, including frame headers, frames, chunks, and related utilities.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a WebSocket frame, including opcode, masking, and payload length.

classes.name: WebSocketFrame
classes.description: Represents an entire WebSocket frame including header and payload.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameChunk
classes.description: Describes a chunk of a WebSocket frame, used for handling large frames in parts.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a WebSocketFrameHeader.

methods.name: WebSocketFrame
methods.description: Constructor for WebSocketFrame, initializes with an opcode.

methods.name: GetWebSocketFrameHeaderSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a WebSocket frame header based on its contents.

methods.name: WriteWebSocketFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebSocket frame header into a buffer.

methods.name: GenerateWebSocketMaskingKey
methods.description: Generates a new masking key for WebSocket frames.

methods.name: MaskWebSocketFramePayload
methods.description: Applies masking or unmasking to WebSocket frame payload data.
